Board of Commissioners
Learn about the Board of Commissioners and the Districts they serve.
Boards & Commissions
Learn about the various boards and commissions that help make decisions regarding the community.
County Clerk
The County Clerk is general recorder of various official County records, such as births, deaths, marriages, business and professional registration and Circuit Court records.
Register of Deeds
Register of Deeds is responsible for recording, indexing and maintaining the records of all deeds, mortgages, liens, and other legal documents affecting real estate in Monroe County.
1st District Court
The 1st District Court will provide access and services to all Court Users in a Fair, Consistent and Timely Manner.
38th Circuit Court
The Circuit Court is the trial court of general jurisdiction in Michigan.
Probate / Juvenile Court
Our mission is to serve the community with integrity, compassion and accountability through delivery of restorative justice.
Friend of the Court
The main function of the Friend of the Court is to enforce the court orders issued by the Circuit Court for Child Support, Custody, and Parenting Time.
Prosecuting Attorney
The mission of the Monroe County Prosecuting Attorney's Office is to promote the ends of justice by effectively and efficiently prosecuting violations of the law, helping to maintain community security, and advancing a fair and reasoned administration of the law - all while safeguarding the rights of victims and the accused, and maintaining the highest ethical and professional standards.
Monroe County Sheriff's Office
Find information about the Monroe County' Sheriff's Office, MIchigan.
County Treasurer
The County Treasurer is the custodian of all county funds, and is responsible for the collection of delinquent real property taxes.
Drain Commission
The Monroe County Drain Commissioner is the manager for over 1100 dedicated county drains.
